Its upper inequality for ALL j follows by testing other feasible trinomials; its lower inequality follows from a one-turning-point real exponential curve, not finite enumeration. Absolute convergence gives a sharp functional bound for all complex coefficient sequences. The same strict certificate gives all equality cases, while an explicit strictly increasing derivative root proves the phase and asymptotics. Exact rational checks corroborate identities. No unproved infinite step or computation is used.
